0.0.4:
## Discord online announcements

Add an optional Discord webhook in Settings → Account. After unlocking your Ochat account with your password, Ochat can post ‘Your name is online on Ochat’ to the Discord channel connected to that webhook. This lets channel members see that you are available on Ochat; it does not send Discord private messages.

- Disabled by default, with a masked URL stored in your encrypted local profile.
- Invisible status suppresses automatic announcements; Tor is respected when enabled.
- One automatic announcement per app launch, plus a rate-limited Send test button.
- The main Settings Save button now saves the announcement toggle while keeping the webhook URL already stored.

## Synchronization fixes

- Messages keep their original send time when delivered or retried after a peer reconnects, with a deterministic order for equal timestamps.
- Background and queued room states no longer replace the selected offline conversation.
- Reconnection regression tests cover three peers, offline recovery and history after restart.

Online announcements intentionally share your display name and online activity with Discord and the configured channel. No chat contents are included.
0.0.5:
## Chat media and conversation improvements

- Play shared audio and video directly in conversations, with playback controls and a mini player.
- Keep managed chat media in encrypted application storage for later playback.
- Improve conversation read state, delivery hints, chat headers and profile cards.
- Show Tor startup progress in the title bar.
- Include the refreshed Friends page, inline requests and presence groups.

## More reliable Windows installers

- Cache the Tauri installer tools between successful main-branch builds.
- Compile the Windows executable once, then retry installer bundling up to four times for temporary download failures such as HTTP 504.
- Keep installer, certificate and integrity failures blocking.

Includes the merged chat-media and conversation-profile improvements from PRs #3 and #4. Existing accounts and protocol remain compatible.

## Update checks

- Point update checks to the current GitHub repository after its rename. Existing 0.0.4 users whose update check is unavailable should download 0.0.5 manually; subsequent checks use the corrected endpoint.
0.0.6:
## Voice and account interface improvements

- Keep participant names readable beside mute, deafen and speaking indicators in voice channels.
- Simplify the group composer by removing the redundant recipient label.
- Add a keyboard-accessible account status menu with availability choices and a shortcut to copy your contact ID.
- Refresh the voice connection card and use a compact participant row for private calls, with connection details and accessible controls.
- Redesign group details with member counts, roles, voice activity, connection quality and direct access to the shared emoji library.

## Reliable release publication

- Keep the GitHub draft ID returned at creation and use it for uploads and publication, avoiding failures when a new draft is not yet visible through tag/list lookups.
- Preserve source-commit and SHA-256 verification and safe recovery from interrupted uploads.

Includes merged PRs #5 and #6. Existing accounts, encrypted history and the peer-to-peer protocol remain compatible.
